image_description: A close-up, black-and-white (or desaturated) photograph of a ceramic teacup resting on a matching saucer. The cup features a decorative band around the rim with a textured pattern and stylized floral or leaf motifs on the body. A C-shaped handle is visible on the right side. The background is blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of vessel (teacup vs mug) and validate material appearance (ceramic/porcelain).
To verify the structural integrity of the handle attachment points, a common failure mode in AI-generated cups.
To ensure the cup sits correctly on the saucer without floating or merging artifacts.
To check for subtle texture anomalies in the glaze or decorative patterns.

focus_areas: Rim continuity and elliptical perspective correctness
Contact shadow between cup base and saucer
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle's connection to the cup body; AI often fails to create a clean hole or merges the handle into the wall. Verify the elliptical shape of the rim is consistent with the base ellipse. Check if the decorative band follows the curvature of the cup correctly without warping.
